name: Chris Darigan
body: I had the good fortune to work with Paul on many occasions at different venues, most notably Local 121 on Washington Street. It was clear from the beginning that Pauly D was a genuine, honest, kind hearted person. His positive attitude was infectious. He navigated through unexpected or difficult circumstances with a strong work ethic and constant positivity. Paul was the rare person you were always glad to see. Pauly D was a breath of fresh air all around Providence. My heart goes out to his family in this very difficult time.
